title: Point lifting to explicit split sections
statement: Let R,H be commutative rings, ι:R→H, g∈R, and C a faithfully flat H-algebra. Let p:Y→Spec R factor through j:Y→D(g). Let t:T→Spec R, k:D(h)→T over Spec R, where h is the image of g in C. Let δ:Y×T≅∐(Fin d)T be over T. Define s_x:D(h)→Y×Spec H by pullback.lift of the x-th fixedSplitSection and the structural map to Spec H. Every point z of Y×Spec H is s_x(a) for some label x and some point a of D(h).

source.place: Tag 03SF, finite Galois covers and permutation sets; faithful-flat point lifting

proof.text: Pull back Spec C→Spec H along the second projection of Y×Spec H. Mathlib flat_and_surjective_SpecMap_iff and faithfullyFlat_algebraMap_iff make this projection b surjective. The pullback condition and factorization through D(g) put its projection c to Spec C in D(h). IsOpenImmersion.lift gives a map a to D(h).

The pair of its map y to Y and a followed by k gives a lift to Y×T, and hence M to its coproduct splitting. For a point above z choose the coproduct label x via sigmaOpenCover. Pull back the x-th coproduct immersion along M; Pullback.range_fst supplies a point above the chosen point.

Postcompose the pullback condition with the coproduct structural map to show n=l≫a≫k. Postcompose it with δ.inv and projection to Y to obtain l≫y=l≫a≫fixedSplitSection x. Pullback.hom_ext then gives l≫b=l≫a≫s_x. Evaluate at the lifted point to give z=s_x(a). The compatibility proof used in the real construction of s_x is the proved fixedSplitSectionOver_compat.

proof_origin.note: Expanded the corresponding step of the parent argument; point lifting is fully proved in Lean.

mathlib_searches.query: Every point of a scheme split by a faithfully flat cover lies on the image of one of the split sections
image of the quotient by a stabilizer in a finite etale cover is exactly the union of labelled sections in its orbit
mathlib_searches.results: PreGaloisCategory.fiberIsoQuotientStabilizer; FintypeCat.isoQuotientStabilizerOfIsConnected; IsFractionRing.stabilizerHom_surjective. None identifies the explicit scheme morphisms in this statement.

No duplicate explicit section over H or orbit image statement in Sheaf or WeilConjectures. Mathlib flat_and_surjective_SpecMap_iff, Pullback.range_fst, IsOpenImmersion.lift, sigmaOpenCover supply point lifting. RingTheory.Invariant.Basic supplies integrality but not the scheme-image criterion.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Used Mathlib ingredients for the proved point-lifting statement; no exact image criterion.
